Marta (CSM): Quick sync 1BR in 3 days for Acme. Need: slide owners, demo lead, onboarding snapshot, renewal note, and a short ROI example. Keep replies short.
Priya (Onboarding): Ill do onboarding slide. Current: ingest 80%, eval pass 92%, blockers: Okta SSO mapping + analytics RBAC.
Lenora (Solutions): Ill own demo. Plan: 6-min live (ingest -> query -> rerank) + perf p50/p95. Need stable demo key and dataset pointer. @Evan confirm dataset.
Evan (Acme): Dataset: catalog-q2. Execs want emphasis on uptime and cost predictability. They want a 15-min pre-brief day-before.
Jordan (Product): I'll prepare roadmap + ROI calc (short). ROI = (hours saved * queries/mo * $/hr). Will keep numbers range-based.
Amir (CS Dir): Renewal flag: sponsor rotated. Recommend 1-slide "Renewal Runway" with sponsor map + asks (intro call, cost review).
Marta (CSM): Action items: Priya (onboard slide) due EOD tomorrow; Lenora (demo steps) due in 24h; Jordan (roadmap+ROI) due tomorrow noon; Amir (renewal slide) draft by EOD. Evan confirm pre-brief time.
Evan (Acme): Pre-brief yes  schedule for 2024-06-27 15:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Event created: Acme EBR pre-brief  2024-06-27 15:00 UTC. Invites sent.
Priya (Onboarding): Okta metadata received. Small issue: ACS URL uses IP alias, escalating to eng-infra; ETA ~4h.
Lenora (Solutions): Demo runbook snippet for notes:
```
1) demo key: acme_demo_temp
2) ingest sample: s3://acme/catalog-q2 -> ./sample
3) curl check: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health check"}'
   expect p95 < 250ms
```
Marta (CSM): Paste bullets into deck notes (link: https://docs.google.com/example). Rehearsal tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Short replies only.
Amir (CS Dir): Add appendix slide: SLA history (uptime, incidents, MTTR) for new sponsor.
Marta (CSM): Got it. Ill post run-of-show after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
